event_summary: A colorful teapot-shaped object remains upright on a black circular base while its visible side gradually changes orientation in front of a mirror.
raw_event_description: At the start, the teapot-shaped object is upright on a black circular base on a wooden tabletop, with its red spout visible on the left and red handle visible on the right. Over the sequence, the body markings, handle, and spout shift around the object's outline, showing a steady turn about its vertical axis while the base, tabletop, mirror, wall, cord, and dark object at the right remain in the same positions. The mirror reflection shows the same orientation changes. By the end, the red handle is more on the left side and the red spout is more on the right side than at the start.

reasons: The main teapot-shaped object, black base, tabletop, mirror, wall, and cord are visible.
The teapot-shaped object appears intact and upright at the beginning.
The event is already in progress as the object's orientation changes continuously through the sequence.
